dataformat.name: smooks
dataformat.title: Smooks
dataformat.description: Transform and bind XML as well as non-XML data, including EDI, CSV, JSON, and YAML using Smooks
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: A Java object graph, such as the beans unmarshal gives, which Smooks reads as a JavaSource. Text, bytes or a stream are not parsed: Smooks reads them as a Java object too

marshalOut.description: The text Smooks writes in UTF-8, such as the XML of the object graph or the output of a template of the config, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: The data the reader of the smooks config reads: XML by default, or EDI, CSV or JSON with a reader

unmarshalOut.description: What the exports of the smooks config give: the bean a JavaSink export extracts (a Map of the beans when it extracts several or none), the text of a StringSink, or a List of the results of several exports (empty without exports)

smooksConfig.description: Path to the Smooks configuration file.

allowExternalEntities.label: security
allowExternalEntities.description: Whether to allow the XML reader used by Smooks to resolve external XML entities (external general and parameter entities) when parsing XML input. This is disabled by default so that external entities in the message body are not resolved; enable it only for trusted legacy configurations that rely on external entity resolution.
